text: Lesson: For any item, append "-2" if mode=amber; append "-9" if mode=blue. Priority (normal/urgent) determines suffix: normal → -2, urgent → -9. Assumption: Unseen combinations (e.g., non-natural items) follow the same rule unless specified.

For any item, append "-2" if mode=amber, "-9" if mode=blue. Prefix with "dax" for amber, "wug" for blue. Priority (normal/urgent) only affects suffix: normal → -2, urgent → -9. Assumption: Unseen items follow the same rule; prefix is determined solely by mode.

For any item: if mode=amber, prefix with "dax" and append "-2"; if mode=blue, prefix with "wug" and append "-2" for normal, "-9" for urgent. Capitalize the item name. Assumption: Unseen items follow identical rules; capitalization and suffix depend only on mode and priority.
